reply.summary: Anvalte is a blond, well-meaning private eye who shares an office and a face with his identical twin. Their cases end in chaos and slapstick, and they rarely notice the clues in front of them.

feats.scene: Anvalte swings a rolled newspaper at a burglar and misses by a mile.
Anvalte tumbles down a flight of stairs with a filing cabinet and is only dazed.

reply.summary: Ialam is a masked fighter from a vigilante band in a small town. He falls early in a bloody scrap and is remembered only for how fast he threw himself into danger.

feats.scene: Ialam charges a gunman and tackles him through a wooden porch rail.
Ialam takes a shotgun blast to the vest before going down.

reply.summary: Reocolu is a young woman who inherits a family legacy of frost crime and takes up an ice weapon to follow it. She was raised in the shadow of a stern grandfather and a rival brother.

feats.scene: Reocolu levels her cold gun and freezes a fountain solid in one pull.
Reocolu slips on her own ice and slams into a bench without a mark.

reply.summary: Renlasam is a proud arena fighter who plays along with a cruel overlord to protect his homeland. He wins bout after bout, is cheered by the crowd, and loses only to an opponent who refuses to humiliate him.

feats.scene: Renlasam lifts a stone slab and slams it through a rival's shield.
Renlasam is buried under a pile of arena rubble and heaves his way out.

reply.summary: Orasonlu is a yellow-skinned gladiator who challenges a famous hero for glory and loses. Later he is kidnapped by a weapon-hoarding rebel who offers him a glorious battle, and he gladly chooses to stay.

feats.scene: Orasonlu hammers a steel gate with both fists and bends it off its hinges.
Orasonlu takes a heavy rocket blast on his chest and laughs.

reply.summary: Asorenum is a masked warrior who defends his homeland alongside other patriots in an armoured crusade. He is killed in a blast that levels a battlefield.

feats.scene: Asorenum strikes a heavy door with a hardened forearm and caves it in.
Asorenum is caught in a huge blast on an open field and holds on a moment longer than expected.

reply.summary: Tacor is a hidden mountain tyrant who rules from the high passes and crushes any intruder who climbs too close. His secret identity is guarded as fiercely as his territory.

feats.scene: Tacor smashes a rope bridge with a spiked club and plunges it into the gorge.
Tacor shrugs off a rockfall on a snowy ledge.

reply.summary: Luausam is a black-haired criminal who strikes once and vanishes behind a serpent mask. His one crime is remembered more than his face.

feats.scene: Luausam hurls a curved blade across a hangar and pins a coat to a crate.
Luausam is knocked into a stack of crates and breaks them without a wince.

reply.summary: Numre is a brilliant scientist who rises to the second seat of an island empire and forges a lethal gas. He joins a cursed chalice to a spear of legend and casts a sphere that bends every hero who enters it.

feats.scene: Numre raises the sphere across two continents and turns a squad of champions against each other.
Numre ducks behind a stone altar as a grenade bursts nearby.

reply.summary: Iuesi is a hairless mercenary who rides a drake-shaped war machine against a team of corporate heroes. His vehicle does most of the work and he does most of the shouting.

feats.scene: Iuesi cuts a van in half with a swipe of his machine's tail.
Iuesi's armour shrugs off a volley of shotgun pellets.

reply.summary: Anutelani is a black-haired criminal in a seven-person syndicate. She wears a costume with glittering wings and relies on speed and surprise.

feats.scene: Anutelani slashes a rope with a wing-edge blade and drops a crate on a guard.
Anutelani lands on a fire escape after a long fall and rolls away.

reply.summary: Amtes is a lab-grown bloodsucker who sleeps in a coffin on a tiny planet. He bursts a flash of light to blind pursuers and knocks mortal reporters flat before they can scream.

feats.scene: Amtes backhands a reporter across a lab and cracks a metal cabinet.
Amtes takes a sprinting tackle and does not budge.

reply.summary: Raall is a small-time white-haired gangster who runs animal fights and darker rackets from a rundown district. He is cruel but not clever, and everyone in his corner of town knows to pay him.

feats.scene: Raall slaps a debtor with the back of his hand and drops him in the gutter.
Raall takes a bottle to the head and just snarls.

reply.summary: Iumtorreo is a being of pure antimatter held inside a sealed containment suit. He fires concentrated blasts and flies faster than light to serve as a future patrol's heavy hitter.

feats.scene: Iumtorreo vents his core in a single blast and carves a crater the size of a city.
Iumtorreo streaks between two planets in a flash of green fire.

reply.summary: Stialrau is a red-eyed dragon who slept for six hundred years and woke craving gold. She breathes fire that twists fear and hatred in anyone she scorches, and was said to be fated to destroy a famous team.

feats.scene: Stialrau exhales a sheet of flame and melts the roofs of a whole town.
Stialrau is struck by a hail of cannon fire and keeps her wings spread.

reply.summary: Micerni is a theatrical masked crook who stages elaborate heists as if they were stage plays. He hams up every robbery and expects applause from the victims.

feats.scene: Micerni fires a prop pistol and a real window shatters.
Micerni tumbles off a stage and takes a bow.

reply.summary: Inuvar is one half of a cybernetic pair who throws and tumbles with unnatural grace. He and his partner run with a gang of kids and menace the local metal-suited hero.

feats.scene: Inuvar hurls a steel drum across a lot and dents a parked truck.
Inuvar lands on pavement after a rooftop leap and keeps running.

reply.summary: Ilollst is a widowed noblewoman with flame-coloured hair who runs a ring of spies for the highest bidder. She clashes with a heroine again and again but always has a new scheme.

feats.scene: Ilollst slaps a double agent across a dinner table.
Ilollst is tossed into a river and swims to the far bank.

reply.summary: Coral is a red-eyed youth raised in an exile prison and trained for one fight with a single target. He resists the poison that hurts his foes and hears the harsh voices of his teachers when he is free.

feats.scene: Coral punches a steel hull and tears a hole big enough to walk through.
Coral takes a full broadside from a cruiser and keeps swinging.

reply.summary: Esttuse is an orange-skinned guardian of a bright sister world who flares into a being of vast power. He is called on when ordinary champions fail.

feats.scene: Esttuse unfolds a ring of light and shatters a mountain peak in a heartbeat.
Esttuse stands in the heart of an energy storm without a scratch.

reply.summary: Urnnia is the cold, ancient king of sleep and stories and one of seven siblings who embody aspects of life. After a century in a cell he sets out to rebuild his shattered realm and rule the dreams of everyone alive.

feats.scene: Urnnia gathers the sand of his realm and reshapes a whole nightmare city in a breath.
Urnnia stands unmoved as his own kingdom collapses into black sand.

reply.summary: Niutantiu is a red-haired sorceress who charms men through their sleep and makes them her servants. She appears once, and then fades like a dream at sunrise.

feats.scene: Niutantiu whispers a command and a sleepwalking guard hurls a table at her pursuer.
Niutantiu takes a rough shove in a dream corridor and fades away.

reply.summary: Rortumiu is a violet-eyed daughter of a bright sister world who travels with a band of youthful wanderers. She never ages and she paints false pictures in the minds of her foes.

feats.scene: Rortumiu conjures a mirage of a charging army and sends a patrol running.
Rortumiu is struck by a runaway cart and stands up unhurt.

reply.summary: Tumllceo is a gentle immortal wanderer whose gift is to plant comforting illusions in a mind. She can look like whatever calms a frightened stranger and can jump through folds in space.

feats.scene: Tumllceo lifts a fallen girder with one arm and tosses it out of a tunnel.
Tumllceo walks out of a collapsed hall without a mark.

reply.summary: Vistisar is a bald, brawny thug who flies and throws blasts of flame as part of a team of extremists. He is a rough pastiche of a more famous menace and leans on brute force.

feats.scene: Vistisar hurls a column of fire across a rooftop and melts a water tower.
Vistisar crashes through three walls and shakes off the plaster.

reply.summary: Stolamil is a shapeless, blob-bodied pirate who commands a crew of odd aliens in deep space. He raids cargo ships and fights a winged officer from another star.

feats.scene: Stolamil oozes through a bulkhead and crushes a cargo robot in his folds.
Stolamil takes a point-blank volley and reforms around the holes.

reply.summary: Amirnte is a blue-skinned grey-haired guardian of a far sector who carries a living lantern and a ring of willpower. He is slain by a rebel tyrant, kept animated by his ring, and later raised again as a hollow soldier.

feats.scene: Amirnte shapes a green hammer from his ring and smashes a pirate cruiser.
Amirnte raises a shield of light and stops a cannon barrage.

reply.summary: Naustil is a bald school delinquent who stores motion as kinetic force and fires it in bursts. He is swift and slick, and he loves smashing public property for fun.

feats.scene: Naustil unleashes a stored volley and flattens a school bus.
Naustil is run out a classroom window and lands on a lawn.

reply.summary: Varseval is a bald television producer on a distant world who stirs up disasters on another planet to keep his show exciting. He uses advanced gadgets to animate towers and make a hero too heavy to stand.

feats.scene: Varseval triggers a device and a speedster sinks through the pavement under his own weight.
Varseval stumbles off a ramp in his own studio and shrugs it off.

reply.summary: Seleo is a robotic member of a star-spanning protectorate who flies and shifts its size as needed. It is loyal, methodical and acts only when its orders allow.

feats.scene: Seleo grows to the size of a house and lifts a crashed cargo skiff.
Seleo is blasted by a pirate cannon and its plating glows red but holds.

reply.summary: Sorseau is a white-furred hound whose drool is a weapon, controlled with astonishing aim. He forms sticky bubbles that trap, soak and daze his foes in a team of space-patrolling pups.

feats.scene: Sorseau flicks a glob of drool and plasters a robot's lens.
Sorseau bounces off a metal crate and wags his tail.

reply.summary: Ninsite is a white-haired conqueror who enslaves a world in a possible tomorrow and renames it for his lost home. He trusts his people's strength and delights in humiliating captured heroes.

feats.scene: Ninsite punches a fortress wall and sends a cloud of masonry across a valley.
Ninsite takes a salvo from an orbital gun and is only singed.

reply.summary: Lurivor is a hard-line general in a rebuilt copy of a lost world who dreams of a coup against a rival house. He is beaten before he can finish his plan, and he promises vengeance to the last.

feats.scene: Lurivor drives his fist through a tank turret and tosses it aside.
Lurivor is hit by a rocket volley and stands up shouting orders.

reply.summary: Rnluos is a once-honoured commander who led a doomed uprising and was exiled to a spectral prison instead of being executed. Free again, he arms himself with a rifle and swears to turn a new planet into his lost home.

feats.scene: Rnluos fires his rifle at a ridge and brings down a slab of cliff.
Rnluos is thrown through a stone wall and rises without a scratch.

reply.summary: Eomil is an amber-eyed leader of the survivors of a lost world who plans to conquer a planet of green-ringed guardians and remake it as a new home. He wields a mighty digging tool shaped like a drill.

feats.scene: Eomil plants his drill-tool in a plain and cracks open a canyon.
Eomil is thrown through a bulkhead on a space station and walks it off.

reply.summary: Ntice is a dark-skinned, grey-haired general trapped in a spectral jail where his body passes through solid walls. He keeps his iron will and his mind-reading skill, and he leads inmates by force of personality.

feats.scene: Ntice reaches through a prison wall and grips a guard's wrist.
Ntice stands in a storm of grey static and is untouched.

reply.summary: Arnusol is a blue-eyed commander who hollows out his world for its core to power a war machine. Knowing the end is near, he touches a pod to stamp his own code on a child who will escape.

feats.scene: Arnusol drills deeper and deeper until the planet's core ruptures in a blinding flash.
Arnusol is knocked flat by a rival's blast and rises with a snarl.

reply.summary: Anlor is a tall, black-eyed ultra-nationalist leader who rebuilds an occupied planet in the image of his own. He murders a young hero with a beam from his eyes and carves his crest into the ice.

feats.scene: Anlor fires a beam from his eyes and burns his insignia into a glacier.
Anlor takes a crushing blow from an armoured suit and stays standing.

reply.summary: Rnticel is a ruthless terrorist freed from a hidden prison with the help of a scheming magnate. He becomes ruler of a pocket world and kills anyone who stands against his rule.

feats.scene: Rnticel hurls a truck through a laboratory wall and brings the ceiling down.
Rnticel is hit by a salvo of missiles and keeps walking toward his target.

reply.summary: Lloleoar is a puffed-up exile who mistakes a pizza courier for an enemy and later opens a hot dog stand to take over a planet. His scheme works until his own sausages turn into monsters.

feats.scene: Lloleoar lobs a giant frankfurter across a street and caves in a shop roof.
Lloleoar is flattened by a runaway ketchup truck and shouts for his lunch.

reply.summary: Amnesam is a revered ancestor of a conquering house who commanded a fleet of star ships that scouted worlds for conquest. His flagship crashed on a distant planet and lay buried for centuries.

feats.scene: Amnesam orders a full broadside from his fleet and levels a fortified plain.
Amnesam walks out of the wreck of his flagship after the crash.

reply.summary: Stoniaesi is a smooth, ruthless official of a time-keeping order who argues that authority makes execution different from murder. He works in secret with a deathless conqueror and dies when his citadel explodes.

feats.scene: Stoniaesi orders an assassin to hunt children across the decades.
Stoniaesi stands at the heart of his collapsing citadel as it detonates.

reply.summary: Monorlli is a balding sorcerer who rules a world smaller than an atom and drinks in the magic of anyone who attacks him. He taunts his opponents with the failures of their parents.

feats.scene: Monorlli points a gnarled staff and a bolt of green light splits a boulder.
Monorlli glows as he swallows an incoming spell and grins.

reply.summary: Illeolsti is a purple-haired outcast who carries thousands of diseases and can choose whom she infects. She is immune herself and serves in a squad of reserve heroes that was turned away.

feats.scene: Illeolsti breathes on a squad of guards and they collapse with fever.
Illeolsti shrugs off a plague that fells a crowded hall.

reply.summary: Mivarau is a joke of a villain who dresses like an insect and kidnaps wealthy matrons for ransom. He is tired of being laughed at, and his latest scheme is more dangerous than it looks.

feats.scene: Mivarau fires a stun gun at a bodyguard and drags a hostage into a van.
Mivarau is thrown from a rooftop by two young vigilantes and limps away.

reply.summary: Vauvi is a petty costumed thief who skips a gathering of rogues and is spared by a monster hunting the others. Even the hero is not worried about his safety.

feats.scene: Vauvi tosses a net at a pigeon and tangles himself in it.
Vauvi trips on a curb and bounces up with a smile.

reply.summary: Seamnt is a cartoon bug-themed crook who wears his goofy suit with a straight face. He schemes for money and is beaten by plucky heroes every time.

feats.scene: Seamnt fires a glue gun at a pair of guards and sticks them together.
Seamnt is flung into a hay wagon and sneezes.

reply.summary: Riariaiu is the younger sister of a famed warrior and the finest archer and rider on her island home. She poses as a teenage sibling in a foreign city and is tricked by spies who reveal where her people live.

feats.scene: Riariaiu looses an arrow from horseback and pins a spy's sleeve to a post.
Riariaiu is knocked senseless by a rag soaked in sleeping fumes.

reply.summary: Revorve is the green-skinned pioneer of a corps of armoured space guards, remembered as tough, clever and dedicated. Others have followed the path he laid down, wearing the same kind of mantle.

feats.scene: Revorve lifts a collapsed beam with his armoured arms and clears a corridor.
Revorve stands in a decompression blast and keeps his post.

reply.summary: Amiiu is a cyborg forged from a simple energy shape by a last elder, sent to test a new ring-bearer. He strikes hard, takes punishment, and drifts from place to place looking for his target.

feats.scene: Amiiu hammers a steel bridge and drops a span into the bay.
Amiiu is hit by a green blast that melts a tank and keeps going.
